records.heading: Copper seal inspection
records.text: The copper seal was inspected on the clean bench before the enclosure was assembled. Its outer edge showed no visible cracks. The observer recorded the seal position in the inspection sheet and left the loose spare in the labeled tray. These observations do not certify the assembly for operation. The inspection sheet also records which bench lamp was used during this visual check.

records.heading: Valve travel inspection
records.text: The disconnected valve moved through its marked travel without catching during the bench check. No pressure was applied. The observer returned the handle to the closed mark and noted the room temperature beside the result. A separate authorized operating check remains necessary before this assembly can be used. The travel marks were compared with the unpowered assembly drawing rather than inferred from memory.

records.heading: Bench handoff record
records.text: At handoff the bench contained the enclosure, the labeled spare tray, and the completed inspection sheet. The power lead remained disconnected. The next operator was asked to compare the sheet with the parts before starting independent checks. The handoff records observed placement, not permission to energize the equipment. Both operators retained their separate checklist copies and left the original sheet beside the enclosure.
